svg.title: Example: test an EWMA risk model

cc:Work.dc:title: Example: test an EWMA risk model
cc:Work.dc:description: Synthetic Gaussian GARCH validation data, alpha 0.025, signed decimal log returns. EWMA: 12 of 499 shared observations at or below VaR (2.4%), compared with nominal 2.5%.
